verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents an OpenAI-compatible hosted API endpoint that the official OpenAI clients can use by pointing `base_url` at it. It also publishes extensive programmatic SDK APIs, covering streaming generation, chat, tool calling, structured output, STT, TTS and model downloads. Together these give a documented public interface that an agent or script can drive. The evidence for the hosted endpoint itself is thin, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec at any standard path. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, detailed endpoint reference (routes, programmatic API-key auth, error and rate-limit behavior), independent hands-on corroboration of using the API.
